def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Categories.csv"
    # The file has a title row; the real header row starts on the next line.
    # Read without header inference, then promote the first data row to header.
    raw = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="cp1252", header=None)
    raw = raw.dropna(how="all")
    raw.columns = [f"c{i}" for i in range(raw.shape[1])]

    # Find the header row that contains the expected labels
    header_idx = raw.index[raw["c0"].astype(str).str.strip().eq("Rank")]
    if len(header_idx) == 0:
        raise ValueError("Could not find header row with 'Rank' in first column")
    h = header_idx[0]

    header = raw.loc[h].astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
    df = raw.loc[h + 1 :].copy()
    df.columns = header

    # Drop footer rows and any blank rows
    df = df.dropna(how="all")
    df = df[~df["Rank"].astype(str).str.contains("Source:", na=False)]

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)

def process(categories2024):
    import pandas as pd

    df = categories2024.copy()

    # Keep rows with numeric report counts; parse thousands separators
    df["reports"] = (
        df["# of Reports"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
    )
    df["reports"] = pd.to_numeric(df["reports"], errors="coerce")
    df = df.dropna(subset=["reports"])

    max_reports = df["reports"].max()
    min_reports = df["reports"].min()

    ratio = float(max_reports / min_reports) if min_reports != 0 else float("nan")

    return pd.DataFrame(
        [{"ratio": ratio, "max_reports": max_reports, "min_reports": min_reports}]
    )
